summary: Tested SDK hop 1 (Expo SDK 54 -> 55: react-native 0.83.10, react 19.2.0, reanimated 4.2.1, gesture-handler 2.30.1) plus the GO1C Live Route build-blocking-fix (ActiveJourneyMap native/web + mapValidation haversine/polyline helpers). App boots cleanly end-to-end (language screen -> consent -> login -> home), no console/page errors, no red screens on any route tested (/, /login, /emergency, /admin-issues, /women/head-out). Login via voicetest2026@example.com succeeded (200) and Issue Reporter FAB tap-to-open still works post-bump. Backend /api/health and /api/auth/login both return 200, confirming backend unaffected. GO1C map verified in BOTH configurations: (1) default flags (GO1C_LIVE_ROUTE unset/false) -> active session screen renders exactly as before, ActiveJourneyMap does not mount (confirmed no 'headout-active-map'/'active-journey-map' testID in DOM); (2) with GO1C_LIVE_ROUTE=true + GO1B_GPS=true + TRUSTED_CIRCLE_RECIPIENT=true (temporarily set then reverted after testing) -> 'headout-active-map' testID is present, Google Maps JS actually loaded (gm-style DOM, markers rendered, only a harmless google.maps.Marker deprecation warning in console, no errors/crashes). HOWEVER, discovered a separate, CRITICAL, already-broken core flow unrelated to the SDK bump or the map fix: app/women/head-out.tsx's own 'no session' redirect (router.replace('/women/head-out/destination')) points to a 3-step wizard that does not exist anywhere in the codebase (no app/women/head-out/ directory at all) -- confirmed via git diff that the manual GO1C paste REMOVED the old inline destination/duration setup form that used to live directly in head-out.tsx and replaced it with this dead redirect. Any user with no existing head-out session (new/first-time user, or a cleared session) who taps 'Heading out? Start' on the home screen, or navigates to Women's Shield > Head Out, lands on the generic Expo Router 'Unmatched Route' page -- the ENTIRE Head Out feature is currently unreachable for new sessions in this preview. I was only able to test the active-session screens (including the map) by manually injecting a fake session object into localStorage to bypass this dead redirect.

ui_bugs.issue: No-session redirect targets '/women/head-out/destination', a route that does not exist in the codebase (no app/women/head-out/ directory present at all). Any user without an existing ws_head_out_session hits the generic 'Unmatched Route' 404 page instead of a destination-setup form. git diff confirms the manual GO1C edit deleted the old inline DestinationPicker + duration-buttons setup UI that previously lived directly in this screen, and replaced it with this now-broken redirect to a wizard that was apparently never built. This blocks the entire Head Out feature end-to-end for first-time/new sessions.
ui_bugs.testID: n/a (Unmatched Route page has no app-specific testID)

action_items: URGENT, separate from the SDK hop: either restore the old inline destination/duration setup form inside head-out.tsx (reverting that part of the GO1C diff) OR build the missing app/women/head-out/destination.tsx (+radius.tsx/circle.tsx per the code's own comments) 3-step wizard before this feature can be considered usable again. Currently NO user can start a new Head Out session in preview.

SDK hop 1 (54->55) itself looks clean: no new crashes, no red screens, all tested routes return 200, FAB and backend regressions pass. Safe to proceed to hop 2 (55->56) once the above Head Out wizard gap is addressed by product/main agent (it is pre-existing from the manual GO1C paste, not caused by the SDK bump).

Minor/non-blocking: expo-doctor still flags @types/react@19.1.10 (expected ~19.2.10) and eslint-config-expo@10.0.0 (expected ~55.0.1) as outdated devDependencies -- cosmetic doctor warning, did not affect any runtime test.
critical_code_review_comments: ActiveJourneyMap.tsx / .web.tsx are well-written, mirror the existing DestinationMapPicker pattern correctly, and correctly gate all device-GPS reads behind parent-supplied props (privacy contract preserved). haversineMeters/distanceToPolylineMeters in mapValidation.ts are correct, pure, and match their doc comments.

The GO1C Live Route feature's own comment block in head-out.tsx ('Setup itself now lives in the 3-step wizard (app/women/head-out/*)') describes a design that was never actually implemented -- the comment references files (destination.tsx, radius.tsx, circle.tsx) that don't exist, suggesting the person who pasted this feature assumed the wizard existed elsewhere or forgot to include it.

Direct browser full-page navigation (page.goto) to in-app routes like /women/head-out and clicking a 'Start' CTA both land on Unmatched Route for a logged-in user with no prior session -- this is a real, reproducible dead-end in the running app, not a test artifact (reproduced twice independently, and confirmed by reading the source + git diff).

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all SDK-55-bump-related regression checks passed; the one failure found -- Head Out wizard redirect -- is a pre-existing gap from the manual GO1C paste, not a regression from this SDK hop)

seed_data_creation: No backend test data created. Temporarily set EXPO_PUBLIC_TRUSTED_CIRCLE_RECIPIENT=true and EXPO_PUBLIC_GO1C_LIVE_ROUTE=true in frontend/.env to verify the map renders, then reverted both back to original values (false / unset) and restarted expo -- .env is back to its pre-test state. Injected a temporary TEST_-prefixed session object into browser localStorage (key ws_head_out_session) during testing only, not persisted server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SDK 54->55 hop itself is verified clean (no crashes anywhere tested). The GO1C build-blocking-fix (ActiveJourneyMap + mapValidation helpers) works correctly in both flag states and should NOT need retesting unless touched again. The one real bug found (dead redirect to a non-existent Head Out wizard) is NOT part of this SDK hop's scope per the problem statement, but it is a CRITICAL, fully-blocking issue for the Women's Shield Head Out feature that the main agent/user should be made aware of regardless -- currently no new session can be started through the UI at all. If retesting after a fix, use the localStorage injection technique documented here (set 'ws_head_out_session' key, keys: destination/startTime/durationMins/radiusMeters/latitude/longitude/recipientLinkIds) as a fallback to reach the active-session screens if the wizard is still not in place.
rca_of_issue: git diff on app/women/head-out.tsx shows the manual 'GO1C Live Route' feature paste removed the imports for DestinationPicker and the local destination/duration input state (destValue, selectedMins, DURATIONS array) that used to let this screen itself create a new session inline. It was replaced by a new effect: 'if (!loading && !session) router.replace("/women/head-out/destination")', with a code comment claiming setup 'now lives in the 3-step wizard (app/women/head-out/*)' -- but no files under app/women/head-out/ exist (confirmed via fd/glob), so this redirect always 404s for a session-less user. Reproduced via direct UI interaction (tapping home screen's 'Start' CTA) and via full-page navigation to /women/head-out, both landing on the generic Unmatched Route page.
